source_errors.evidence: Common opening requires every x in equation domain, although logarithmic candidates have a smaller interval of definition.
source_errors.normal_repair: Check all x in an interval where the proposed function is defined and the equation is valid; state logarithmic interval explicitly.
source_errors.raw_replay: All nine original strings retained through raw_<source-id>_bank profiles, evidence_only=true, eligible_for_learning=false.

limitations: Observed categorical banks reproduce exact combinations; intent behind impossible II-only/III-only distractors is not inferred.
Raw logarithmic sources omit an explicit x>0 clause and retain the original overly broad domain sentence as ineligible evidence; normal questions repair both.
Hard difficulty is authored, not an observed rating.
Moderate wrong derivative uses coefficient-minus-exponent, one plausible operation matching the single observed scalar; historical error intent is underdetermined.
